scope: Approved instance-owned aggregate HTTP/RPC buffered-memory limiter for the client connection bridge.
implementation: Buffered bridge entry points share one instance-owned limiter, reserve conservatively before intake, reject above the bounded budget deterministically, and release only after cancellation, disconnect, and owned request/response work quiesce. Shared and dedicated RPC paths use the policy while streaming remains outside buffered accounting.

commands.command: pnpm exec tsc -p packages/client/connection/tsconfig.host.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/client/connection/tsconfig.client.json --noEmit

acceptance.summary: The aggregate limiter policy, cancellation/disconnect/quiescence release cases, focused tests, both package faces, lint, documentation pairing, and scoped whitespace checks are current.

limitations: The evidence is from an uncommitted working tree and is not immutable release evidence.
No production RSS/OOM claim or external deployment action is made.
